_note: Recorded generate result for an Amazon Bedrock call (e.g. anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet on Bedrock, no extended thinking). Usage is stored in the high-level ai@7 LanguageModelUsage shape — the @ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock provider maps Bedrock's { inputTokens, outputTokens } onto this canonical shape, and generateText's asLanguageModelUsage is what module.normalize/normalizeUsage consume in prod. No reasoning details, so normalizeUsage.reasoning must be 0 (a number, never null).
